 Friday Night Frenzy District Finals Highlights and Scores 
 WILX Friday Night Frenzy (WILX) By Ben Shockley Published : Nov. 6, 2026 at 11:55 PM EST | Updated : 20 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LANSING, Mich. (News 10) - The district finals round of the MHSAA 11-player football playoffs drew 13 Mid-Michigan teams looking to punch their ticket to the next round, with 11 in action Friday and two more playing Saturday.
 Our Game of the Week was a Division 6 district final matchup featuring two area teams: four-time defending state champions Jackson Lumen Christi (8-2) hosting Napoleon (9-1) , with the Pirates seeking revenge after losing to Lumen Christi in the district finals last year.
 Game of the Week: Jackson Lumen Christi 37, Napoleon 0 
 Highlights: DeWitt 54, Coopersville 21 
 Highlights: Mason 49, Fenton 0 
 Highlights: Pewamo-Westphalia 41, Elkton-Pigeon-Bay Port Laker 7 
 Highlights: Goodrich 42, St. Johns 7 
 More Mid-Michigan Scores: 
 Portland 35, Edwardsburg 17
 Belding 28, Olivet 20
 Jonesville 52, Union City 30
 Hudson 35, Fowler 0
 Springport 34, Decatur 22
 Saturday Matchups: 
 Grand Ledge at East Kentwood
 Portland St. Patrick vs. Grand Rapids Sacred Heart (8-player regional final)
